name: @danilocaffaro/nexusos
description: NexusOS Core Local for human-agent teams

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:runner && npm run test:migrations && npm run test:release && npm run test:integration && npm run build && npm run test:smoke
scripts.test:migrations: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test tests/migrations.test.mjs tests/admission-policy-migration.test.mjs tests/assigned-storage-migration.test.mjs tests/engine-inventory-migration.test.mjs tests/engine-control-storage-migration.test.mjs tests/engine-receipt-migration.test.mjs tests/engine-run-creation-migration.test.mjs tests/lease-preflight.test.mjs tests/lease-preflight-cli.test.mjs tests/sites-migration-package.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node tests/governance-api.integration.mjs && node tests/presence-api.integration.mjs && node tests/realtime-api.integration.mjs && node tests/artifacts-api.integration.mjs && node tests/runners-api.integration.mjs && node tests/engine-run-keyring-api.integration.mjs && node tests/engine-run-options-api.integration.mjs && node tests/engine-run-excerpt-api.integration.mjs && node tests/runs-api.integration.mjs && node tests/cli-session-observation-read-model.integration.mjs && node tests/cli-session-observation-api.integration.mjs && node tests/local-engine-ready.integration.mjs && npm run test:usability
scripts.lint: eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next && oxlint . --ignore-pattern .next --ignore-pattern .wrangler --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern out --ignore-pattern build --ignore-pattern next-env.d.ts
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/state
